pages.raw_meta: ITT is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, and energy markets.
raw_blocks: We are a manufacturer of critical, engineered components that serve fast-growing end markets in transportation, flow, energy, aerospace and defense. Our company’s differentiation is sustained through a combination of several factors, including execution, the quality of our leadership and our people.
Through our people we make an enduring impact on the world

We are committed every day to reflecting our core principles. These principles not only enhance our ability to achieve our purpose, they also define our high-performing culture and help us deliver on our ambitious growth strategy.
Learn more about our principles

Around the world, we have a clear vision of where key industries are headed and how we can help customers reach their goals by thinking our way around obstacles, creating solutions and finding answers to complex technical and engineering challenges. Our customers rely on our expertise to create better products to serve their customers and at the same time increase uptime and energy efficiency in their manufacturing operations.
Learn more about our solutions

We produce our wide range of innovative products and solutions through three operating segments: Flow Technologies, Motion Technologies, and Connect and Control Technologies. Within these businesses, our 10,000 team members serve customers in approximately 125 countries around the globe and are outstanding ambassadors for our well-known and long-standing product brands, which include Goulds and Bornemann pumps, KONI shock absorbers, Cannon connectors and Enidine energy absorption components, to name a few.
Learn more about our brands

We strive to make our work environment inclusive and welcoming. By encouraging a healthy, high-performing culture and by making our customers central to everything we do, we create an atmosphere that enhances innovation and the success of our talented employees. Together, our purpose and principles guide our words and actions every day and are truly touchstones that unite employees across ITT as we aim to develop solutions to complex challenges and make a positive and enduring impact.
Learn more about working at ITT

pages.raw_meta: ITT is a diversified leading manufacturer of highly engineered critical components and customized technology solutions for the transportation, industrial, and energy markets.
raw_blocks: With over 90 years of aerospace technology development, Aerospace Controls is leading the way in design, engineering and manufacturing of top-of-the-line actuators, fluid control devices and environmental control systems for the aerospace and defense industries. We strive to continuously offer new, cutting-edge products that set us apart and make us a leader in the global aerospace technology markets.

Anhydro® designs drying, evaporation and powder processing solutions for dairy, food, pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers. The portfolio combines proven process technologies, engineering expertise and complete turnkey systems to help manufacturers improve product quality, optimize energy efficiency and maximize production performance. Supported by Innovation Center capabilities and comprehensive lifecycle support, Anhydro helps manufacturers develop, scale and optimize processes with confidence throughout the life of their plant.

APV® develops process technologies and end-to-end processing solutions for dairy, food, beverage, pharmaceutical, personal care and industrial manufacturers. From heat exchangers and thermal processing to membrane filtration, homogenization, microparticulation and automation, APV helps manufacturers improve product quality, production efficiency and operational performance. Backed by more than a century of engineering innovation, Innovation Centers and comprehensive lifecycle support, APV helps manufacturers develop new products, optimize processes and maximize long-term value.

With more than 90 years of tradition, Axtone is an expert in impact energy absorption technology. Across mission-critical applications including defense, industrial, rail, automotive, heavy vehicle and power generation, operators demand the highest standards for safety, durability and performance and trust Axtone to design and deliver customized energy absorption components and solutions.

With more than four decades of industry-leading experience and a culture of forward-looking innovation, BIW Connector Systems designs and delivers highly engineered electrical penetrator solutions for the upstream oil and gas industry, performing safely and reliably in the harshest environments to help oil and gas companies meet the demands of their global customers.

From seawater to heavy fuel, the properties of media being conveyed through ITT Bornemann pumps vary widely by viscosity, pressure, volume and temperature. With numerous ground-breaking pump developments over the decades, ITT Bornemann provides proven pumping solutions for customers in industries including chemical, food &beverage, oil & gas and medical & pharmaceutical for nearly any conveyed media.

Bran+Luebbe provides precision metering, process pump, chemical injection, and analytical solutions that help customers across the oil & gas, chemical, water treatment, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, and power industries optimize process performance, accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.

Offshore production platforms, particularly those in remote and deep water locations must have a reliable and cost-effective source of fresh water to operate effectively. Focused solely on solving critical problems for oil and gas operations, ITT C’treat solutions play a major role in addressing global water supply challenges on more than 400 offshore installations.

Whether delivering critical specs to aircraft pilots, providing charging solutions for electric vehicles, streaming data for mission-critical defense applications or giving expectant parents a first look at their unborn children, connector solutions from Cannon connect important information with those who need it in industries such as medical and pharmaceutical, defense, auto and heavy vehicle, industrial and aerospace.

Co-Operative Industries Aerospace and Defense (CIA&D) manufactures electrical wiring harnesses, ignition leads and flexible metal conduit for the commercial airline and defense industries. In addition to manufacturing capabilities, CIA&D’s on-site FAA & EASA certified Repair Station supports major airlines and Maintenance, Repair, and Overhauls (MROs). With quick turnaround time and cost effective electrical harness repairs, CIA&D saves maintenance operators both time and money.

With the increased use of robotics and the drive toward greater automation, industrial manufacturers increasingly require powerful, durable and highly configurable motion control products. Compact Automation delivers innovative components such as air cyliders, grippers, slides and actuators needed to solve complex problems in general industrial, food and beverage, material handling, oil and gas, and automotive applications.

Compulink manufactures cable and wire harness assemblies that incorporate printed circuit boards, fans, switches, power supplies, panel assemblies and other high level components for industrial, military and medical applications. Compulink is a one stop shop for wire harness assembly, coax assemblies, electromechanical assemblies, and custom molded cable assemblies.

Conoflow designs and manufactures low and high pressure regulators, filter regulators, positioners, transducers, actuators and diaphragm seals in a wide variety of materials and configurations to meet a broad range of industrial process control applications worldwide. Complimenting this industrial product lineup is an extensive range of innovative products focused on alternative fuel sources, such as an environmentally-friendly compressed natural gas (CNG) regulator.

Whether handling delicate biopharmaceutical compounds, corrosive and erosive chemicals, or the most abrasive mining slurry, manufacturers require industrial valve solutions that solve their unique challenges. With more than 60 years of building innovative and reliable valves, ITT Engineered Valves has the right valve solution for the most critical applications, with proven performance in various industries including chemical processing, food & beverage, industrial process, mining, oil & gas, power generation, and medical & pharmaceutical.
Aerospace and Defense Industrial Energy Rail

Whether protecting structures from seismic events, preventing mechanical shock in automated and storage retrieval systems, or providing noise abatement in passenger aircraft, Enidine has unique product solutions to meet these critical challenges. For close to 60 years, Enidine has produced highly engineered energy absorption and vibration isolation components such as shock absorbers, rate controls, air springs, wire rope isolators and heavy duty buffers for critical end-markets including, robotics, food and beverage, general industrial, oil and gas, automotive, military and commercial aviation.

The Charles E. Gillman Company has been a trusted partner in wiring virtually every type of U.S. military ground vehicle. Our unmatched experience in manufacturing military-grade wiring harnesses and cable assemblies has made Gillman a go-to source for defense contractors seeking reliability, performance, and precision under the harshest operating conditions.

Since the debut of the first all-metal pump in the mid-1800s, the pump engineers at ITT Goulds Pumps have worked closely with industries worldwide to develop the innovative pump products and technologies required by their demanding applications. ITT Goulds Pumps is a world leader in hydraulics, materials science, mechanical design, fluid dynamics and green energy – with extensive experience in nearly every type of driver, bearing, seal, piping and nozzle configuration, flange and baseplate design to meet most pump application needs in sectors including chemical, food & beverage, industrial process, mining, oil & gas, and power generation.

Valves & Actuators that perform in demanding applications, has been our legacy since 1949. Our heavy-duty products are designed and manufactured using the expertise and knowledge that we have created with our customers and by innovating to solve their ever-developing challenges. Superior performance, best-of-breed designs, meeting and certifying for the most demanding industry standards, and durability with minimal maintenance is what our products provide. with our close technical support and engineering cooperation, leaders in multiple demanding industries are speccing our valves, actuators, and valve automation solutions in their products and systems.

Johnson Pump develops and manufactures high-performance pumping solutions for industrial, marine, and specialized applications worldwide, leveraging engineering expertise, modular product design and customer-focused innovation to solve complex fluid-handling challenges.

Johnson Pump’s marine division provides high-performance pumping and fluid handling solutions for leisure and commercial vessels, offering a comprehensive portfolio that includes bilge, cooling, freshwater, fuel transfer, circulation, wastewater, and pressure water systems. Known for innovative impeller technology and dependable operation in demanding environments, the brand helps enhance vessel performance, safety, comfort, and reliability worldwide.
Automotive Aerospace and Defense Rail

KONI is recognised globally as an intelligent company developing suspension solutions unique for every application. Since revolutionizing the suspension industry with the invention of the first adjustable hydraulic shock absorber, KONI continues to serve and solve customers’ toughest suspension challenges. KONI develops specialized shock absorbers for markets including automotive, defense, rail and heavy vehicle. KONI products are developed using highest quality, durable materials, which exceed the requirements needed for comfort, safety and handling performance. Innovations continue to drive the company forward such as our automotive innovations like the patented mechanical technology, the FSD (Frequency Selective Damping) valve, or our latest Heavy Duty innovation, the HYDRORIDE suspension range.

kSARIA manufactures fiber optic and electrical cable assemblies and harnesses used in harsh environment interconnect applications. kSARIA offers unmatched advantages for all aspects of Mil/Aero Connectivity Solutions from cable assembly, design, and fabrication. Whether it is optical fiber, electrical or hybrid cable assemblies, kSARIA has the technology and expertise to optimize nearly every solution to meet the demands of leading aerospace and defense customers.

Every process depends on reliable mixing. Whether blending ingredients, suspending solids, promoting chemical reactions or optimizing mass transfer, mixing performance directly impacts product quality, operational efficiency and plant reliability. For more than 100 years, the Lightnin brand has helped manufacturers solve complex mixing challenges through application expertise, proven technology and continuous innovation. We partner with customers to design mixing solutions that improve process performance, reduce energy consumption, minimize downtime and lower total cost of ownership. From portable mixers to heavy-duty top-entry and side-entry systems, every Lightnin mixer is engineered for demanding applications across water and wastewater, chemical processing, mining, energy, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals and biofuels. Backed by decades of engineering expertise, the Lightnin brand delivers reliable mixing solutions that help customers improve efficiency, increase productivity and keep critical operations running.

For over 40 years Micro-Mode Products has provided the military, aerospace and commercial industries with an extensive portfolio of standard or custom RF and Hermetic solutions including adapters, blindmate, threaded, and cable assemblies. Our US manufacturing facility offers complete in-house manufacturing capabilities including engineering and design services, a plating lab, and glass to metal sealing operations.

Neo-Dyn provides standard and custom compact adjustable switches, pressure switches, hazardous area switches, vacuum switches, and temperature switches for the global oil & gas, chemical process, and energy markets. Our leadership in designing high-performing, reliable, switch technologies such as our patented negative rate disc spring, has set the standard for the industry. Neo-Dyn’s commercial and industrial switches have the highest quality and most competitive pricing available in the industry.

Complex industrial processes demand mixing solutions that deliver reliable performance at scale. For more than 65 years, the Philadelphia Mixing Solutions brand has helped customers optimize critical operations with engineered systems designed for efficiency, reliability and long-term performance.

Efficient liquid storage and blending depend on reliable mixing. For more than 70 years, the Plenty brand has helped customers optimize tank performance with engineered side-entry mixing solutions designed for demanding industrial applications. Built on decades of application expertise, Plenty delivers high-performance mixers for oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical, and food & beverage industries. Our engineered solutions improve blending, maintain product homogeneity, reduce sludge accumulation and support efficient heat transfer while minimizing energy use and maintenance requirements.

For owners and operators, equipment reliability and uptime is directly related to profitability. Leveraging vast experience, ITT PRO Services has a goal of improving the profitability of our customers in sectors including chemical, food & beverage, industrial process, mining, oil & gas, power generation, and medical & pharmaceutical by targeting the biggest issues of process uptime and energy costs and by monitoring equipment to help make crucial maintenance decisions before problems occur.

A specialist in corrosion and wear resistant materials, Rheinhütte Pumpen has a 160-year heritage and is regarded as a leading provider of highly engineered pumps suited for the handling of some of the world’s most aggressive media. With more than 20 different pump types, Rheinhütte’s solutions serve specialty applications for the chemical, mining, renewable energy and refinery processes and include solutions for sulfuric acid, molten sulfur, fertilizer and chlorine-alkali electrolysis production among others.

Seital develops precision separation and clarification technologies for dairy, beverage, pharmaceutical and industrial manufacturers. The portfolio combines advanced centrifugal separation systems, engineering expertise and process knowledge to improve product quality, maximize product recovery and optimize operational efficiency. Supported by Innovation Center capabilities, pilot testing and comprehensive lifecycle support, Seital Separation helps manufacturers evaluate, scale and optimize processes while delivering reliable long-term performance.

Reliable mixing is essential to product quality, process consistency and operational efficiency. For nearly 80 years, the Stelzer brand has delivered engineered mixing solutions for applications where precision, hygiene and reliability are critical. Built on decades of process expertise, Stelzer develops customized mixing systems for the food & beverage, dairy, chemicals, biogas, and other industrial markets. Every solution is designed to meet demanding process requirements while supporting product integrity, efficient cleaning and long-term performance.

Svanehøj is a global leading specialist in handling critical liquids. We are set to make a difference and take pride in having the knowledge and solutions to develop a fast transition to a greener tomorrow.

Tigerholm delivers innovative HVAC, combustion optimization, and fluid management technologies that improve energy efficiency, system reliability, and installation productivity across residential, commercial, industrial, and transportation applications.

TopFlite Components is a vertically integrated manufacturer of electrical interconnect techology. TopFlite Components manufactures a wide array of high-quality connector products from circular, D-Sub, push-pull, micro-miniature, PCB mount, Micro-D, power, hermetic, filter, and Mil-Spec equivalents. It also manufactures an extensive line of backshells, mold/shrink boot adapters, protective covers, shield termination and custom design interconnect products.

Mining and hydrometallurgical processes demand mixing solutions that perform reliably under the toughest operating conditions. For decades, the Uutechnic brand has helped customers improve process performance with engineered agitators designed for abrasive slurries, large process tanks and demanding industrial applications. Built on deep application expertise, Uutechnic develops customized mixing solutions that support efficient solids suspension, reliable process performance and long equipment life. Every system is engineered to meet the unique challenges of mining and hydrometallurgical operations, helping customers improve productivity while reducing maintenance and operating costs. From process engineering to heavy-duty agitator design, the Uutechnic brand delivers dependable mixing solutions that keep critical operations running with confidence.

In an increasingly global economy, getting from Point A to Point B on time and on budget is more important than ever. ITT Veam connectors are trusted by rail manufacturers and operators to protect products and people in transit so they can get to where they are going safely.

VIDAR is an innovative leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced energy-efficient motors for industrial fluid delivery systems. Specializing in the integration of variable-speed intelligence directly into motor technology, VIDAR provides sustainable solutions that significantly reduce energy consumption and operational costs. Committed to transforming industrial performance, VIDAR motors offer enhanced efficiency, reliability, and space-saving design.

Waukesha Cherry-Burrell® is part of ITT’s expansive portfolio of world-class process technology brands, serving food, dairy, beverage, pharmaceutical, chemical, personal care and industrial processing applications. Our portfolio includes positive displacement and centrifugal pumps, sanitary valves, dispersion equipment and the legendary Votator® scraped surface heat exchangers. Built with durable, easy-to-clean stainless-steel construction, Waukesha Cherry-Burrell equipment helps support reliable performance, efficient operation and consistent product quality across demanding processing environments. From handling a wide range of viscosities and pressures to helping improve throughput and reduce operating costs, our solutions are engineered to keep production moving — backed by experienced, responsive engineering support.
